title: There are 2.5 million ants for every human 🐜
description:
Twenty quadrillion ants live on Earth. Shared out, that's about two and a half million each, and together they outweigh every wild bird and wild mammal combined.

Sources: Schultheiss et al., "The abundance, biomass, and distribution of ants on Earth", PNAS (2022) https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.2201550119 ; https://phys.org/news/2022-09-earth-harbours-ants-wild-birds.html ; world population: https://www.census.gov/newsroom/stories/world-population-day.html

meta.topic: how many ants live on Earth (20 quadrillion)

speaker: ved

scenes.say: Twenty *quadrillion* ants are alive on Earth, right now.
That's a two, followed by *sixteen zeros*.
Way too big to picture. So let's *share them out*.
Split them between all *eight billion* people on Earth...

layers.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 900 300'><rect width='900' height='300' rx='34' fill='#f6efe2'/><rect width='900' height='300' rx='34' fill='none' stroke='#1a1410' stroke-width='6'/><text x='450' y='118' text-anchor='middle' font-size='66' fill='#1a1410' font-family='Anton, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif'>20 QUADRILLION ANTS</text><text x='450' y='200' text-anchor='middle' font-size='64' fill='#d98a1a' font-family='Anton, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif'>/  8 BILLION PEOPLE</text><rect x='300' y='228' width='300' height='10' rx='5' fill='#1a1410' opacity='0.2'/></svg>

scenes.say: ...and every single person gets around *two and a half million* ants.
Now put every ant on Earth on one side of a giant scale...
...and every wild *bird* and wild *mammal* on the other.

beat.text:
Ants walking past every lion on Earth:
*"What's up, brah?"*

scenes.say: All together, they weigh about *a fifth* as much as every human alive.

layers.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 900 380'><rect width='900' height='380' rx='34' fill='#f6efe2'/><rect width='900' height='380' rx='34' fill='none' stroke='#1a1410' stroke-width='6'/><text x='60' y='92' font-size='54' fill='#1a1410' font-family='Poppins, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif' font-weight='800'>WEIGHT OF ALL...</text><text x='60' y='170' font-size='46' fill='#1a1410' font-family='Poppins, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif' font-weight='800'>HUMANS</text><rect x='280' y='128' width='560' height='54' rx='14' fill='#34425c'/><text x='60' y='270' font-size='46' fill='#1a1410' font-family='Poppins, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif' font-weight='800'>ANTS</text><rect x='280' y='228' width='112' height='54' rx='14' fill='#7a2e1c'/><text x='410' y='270' font-size='60' fill='#d98a1a' font-family='Anton, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif'>~ 1/5</text><text x='60' y='340' font-size='30' fill='#5a4636' font-family='Poppins, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif' font-weight='800'>about 12 million tonnes of carbon</text></svg>

scenes.say: So next time one ant *crashes your picnic*...
...relax. He's just one of *your* two and a half million.
